dedupeText: mid century crooner album layout 1960s burnt orange portrait frame serif typography mid century modern centered composition the portrait is the central focal point framed by a yellow border and a larger black line rectangle the text is tightly integrated with the top edge of the framing rectangle the large orange field acts as a massive border pushing all content toward the vertical center combine a large field of a single warm mid tone color with a centered multi framed portrait and tightly packed high contrast serif display type

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered, vertically-oriented layout featuring a photographic portrait framed by thin black lines and nested within a large field of solid burnt orange. The design uses tight, high-contrast serif typography stacked above the image, creating a formal, mid-century aesthetic.
coreVisualRelationships: The portrait is the central focal point, framed by a yellow border and a larger black-line rectangle.
The text is tightly integrated with the top edge of the framing rectangle.
The large orange field acts as a massive border, pushing all content toward the vertical center.
coreInvariants: Thin black vertical lines extending to the bottom edge
High-contrast serif typography with tight tracking

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Central portrait occupying approximately 40% of the vertical height, framed by a yellow border.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eyes looking slightly upward and to the right.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Top-down flow: Title text -> Artist name -> Tracklist block -> Portrait.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive solid orange negative space on the left and right margins.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale Yellow (Inner frame and artist name)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation background with low-value black text and high-value yellow accents.

letterConstructionRules: Extremely tight letter spacing (kerning) where characters nearly touch
High stroke contrast between thick and thin lines
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'y' has a long, elegant descender
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Varying weights and colors of the same high-contrast serif family.
graphicDevices: Yellow inner border around the photo
Vertical rules extending to the bottom

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high contrast and tight spacing typical of the era's display type.
Provides the necessary sharp serifs and verticality for the artist name.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a solid burnt orange background. In the center, place a vertical rectangular frame defined by thin black lines. Inside the top half of the frame, place a block of placeholder text. Inside the bottom half, place a portrait of a man in a suit with a yellow border. Two thin black lines should extend from the bottom corners of the frame to the bottom edge of the canvas.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in black high-contrast serif above the frame. Add the artist name in pale yellow condensed serif inside the top of the frame. Add the tracklist in small black sans-serif or serif below the artist name.

verificationChecks: Is the background a consistent, solid burnt orange?
Is the typography tightly kerned so letters almost touch?
Are the vertical lines perfectly straight and extending to the bottom?
Is the portrait framed by a distinct yellow border?

postGenerationChecks: Check for centered alignment of all elements.
Ensure the orange color is warm and saturated.
Verify that the text does not overlap the portrait.
Confirm the presence of the yellow inner border.
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine a large field of a single warm mid-tone color with a centered, multi-framed portrait and tightly-packed high-contrast serif display type.
